title: salvia obovata
intro: Salvia obovata, commonly known as the "Blue Sage", is a species of flowering plant in the sage family (Lamiaceae). This plant is used in traditional medicine due to its numerous health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, helping to alleviate symptoms of various conditions such as fever, cough, and cold. The therapeutic actions of Salvia obovata include its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory effects, which aid in wound healing and soothing respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents responsible for its medicinal properties include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and rosmarinic acid, among others.
